ctgov.note: All 3 sponsor-linked P1-3 trials are TERMINATED or WITHDRAWN; remaining Edwards-sponsored trials are post-market device studies (not P1/P2/P3 drug development).

commercial_product.note: Edwards is a structural heart medical device company. Marketed franchises (per 10-K Overview, FY2025): Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (SAPIEN 3 / SAPIEN 3 Ultra / SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA), Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies (PASCAL Precision, EVOQUE tricuspid valve replacement system), Surgical Structural Heart (INSPIRIS RESILIA, KONECT RESILIA, MITRIS RESILIA). Devices are regulated under PMA/IDE pathways, not the IND/NDA drug pathway.
